exploreSubtitle: Everything you need to build an ERP integration.
quickStartSubtitle: Send your first API request in minutes.

hero.title: Integrate with
hero.description: The Daqiq Public API lets you sync orders, products, stock, and customers with your systems — all through a simple REST API authenticated with tenant-issued API keys.

auth.title: Authentication
auth.description: Secure your integration with API keys sent via the X-Api-Key header on every request.

orders.title: Orders
orders.description: List, create, and cancel sales orders with idempotent creation and full line-item details.

catalog.title: Catalog & Stock
catalog.description: Read products, check available quantity across warehouses, and query inventory locations.

scopes.title: Scoped Access
scopes.description: Grant only the permissions an integration needs — read orders, write orders, cancel, products, stock, and more.

errors.title: Structured Errors
errors.description: Every error returns a stable code you can branch on, with localized messages and trace IDs for support.

rateLimits.title: Rate Limits
rateLimits.description: 120 requests per minute per key with clear 429 handling — predictable limits for production integrations.

quickStartSteps.step1Desc: Create a key in Daqiq → Settings → API Keys at app.daqiqerp.com. Keys start with daqiq_live_ and are shown only once.
quickStartSteps.step2Desc: Call GET /v1/public/ping to verify credentials and see granted scopes.
quickStartSteps.step3Desc: POST to /v1/public/orders with customer details and line items.
